title: Interop needle regression prober for multipart streamed toolcalls
creator: Lina Park
description:
Goal: Add a compact, targeted regression prober that exercises multipart/streamed tool/function call scenarios with partial JSON payloads, interleaved text chunks, and KV-cache priming. The prober is intentionally small ("needle") to run fast in CI and surface regressions that large golden suites miss: subtle ordering regressions, partial-chunk JSON truncation, and fallback-to-ndjson behavior when tooling emits malformed chunks.

Scope: design a matrix of 18 focused cases that combine: (1) streaming text interleaved with toolcall messages, (2) partial JSON objects across chunks, (3) tool fallback paths (stubbed vs full integration), and (4) cold vs warmed KV-cache priming. Implement harness as an independent pytest module that can run as a fast CI job and as a local dev smoke test.

Out of scope: full golden prompt coverage and behavioral fingerprinting across all model versions. This prober complements, not replaces, the broader compatibility and golden prompt suites.
acceptance_criteria: A compact pytest module (tests/interop_needle.py) that runs 18 parametrized cases and completes under 3 minutes in CI
Each case asserts: correctness of reconstructed JSON payloads, preserved toolcall boundaries, and defined fallback behavior when a chunk is malformed
CI pipelines include a fast 'needle-interop' job that gates merges for streaming runtime changes
Observability: failing cases emit a structured failure log with reproducible golden input and capture of raw chunk stream
Integration: uses existing test stubs for external tools when available and documents trade-offs for full integration runs

test_matrix: stream+toolcall: single toolcall fully in one chunk (control)
stream+toolcall: toolcall payload split over two chunks, closing brace in second chunk
interleaved: text chunk -> toolcall start -> text chunk -> toolcall end
malformed_chunk: missing comma between fields -> expect ndjson fallback
kv_priming: warmed KV-cache vs cold (cache causes different latency profiles)
stubbed_tool_timeout: tool returns partial response then times out -> runtime fallback
multipart_attachments: binary placeholder chunks interleaved with JSON toolcalls
reordering_sim: out-of-order chunk arrival simulated by replayer
partial_json_array: array elements split across chunks
function_call_meta: function call metadata arrives after body chunks
stream_concurrency: two interleaved toolcalls for same session
gc_pressure: long-lived stream with intermittent small chunks
ndjson_fallback_smoke: intentionally malformed to assert ndjson parsing path
backpressure_recovery: simulate backpressure and ensure stream resumes
prefix_caching: verify prefix-based cache hits preserved across toolcalls
tls_disconnect: abrupt connection drop and verify client-visible error
ci_jobs: needle-interop-smoke (fast, runs on PRs changing streaming/runtime code)
needle-interop-nightly (full variants, optional Dedicated staging run)
needle-interop-upload-artifact (on failure, archive raw chunk stream)
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives from model nondeterminism and flaky network timing produce noisy failures. Mitigation: keep inputs deterministic via model shim and replayer; introduce retry-on-flaky with automatic re-run metadata; separate CI job for flaky clusters and require two consecutive failures before filing an incident.
